name: Divo Attrice
original_name: ディヴォ・アットリーチェ
source: A famous actress. She was involved in a stage murder. The prop knife, that was supposed to have a retractable blade, was switched for a real poisoned knife, killing a journalist that changed places with the actor that was supposed to be stabbed in the play.
